msdfgen 1.13
https://github.com/Chlumsky/msdfgen (tag v1.13)

Kept: core/, msdfgen.h, ext/import-font.{h,cpp} (glyph outlines through
FreeType) and LICENSE.txt. Dropped: the command line tool (main.cpp), the
other extensions - PNG saving (libpng), SVG import (tinyxml2), shape
geometry resolution (Skia) - and msdfgen-ext.h, which includes them all.
deps/CMakeLists.txt builds it with MSDFGEN_PUBLIC and MSDFGEN_USE_CPP11
defined, so msdfgen-config.h is not needed.
